dispositions.rationale: The double-submit CSRF token is readable by design: the single-page application reads it and returns it as a request header, which is why SecurityConfiguration builds the repository with withHttpOnlyFalse. The session cookie issued beside it does carry HttpOnly.

The rule reads the second half of a URL, //www.w3.org/2000/svg, as a line comment in a minified bundle and matches the word query from a.querySelector later on the same line. The bundle contains neither a comment nor a query at that position.
The rule reports that the response is a script-driven application without navigable links, which is what a single-page application is.

The rule reports that the response sets a recognised session cookie. Every route that reaches the application answers an unauthenticated request with a problem detail and a fresh session, including paths this instance does not serve at all.
